page.overview:
What is Nilfgaardian Military Intelligence?

The Nilfgaardian or Imperial Military Intelligence is the Nilfgaardian Empire's intelligence agency but, despite being the largest country on the continent, it's only the second-largest intelligence agency next to the renowned and efficient Redanian Secret Service.

Ever patient in its goals, Nilfgaard carried out several long-term missions within the Northern forces themselves, such as with Gwalter aep Llwynog, an imperial spy sent by General Ardal aep Dahy. Using the alias Xavier Lemmens, he joined Aedirn's forces stationed in the city of Rosberg several years before the actual war. While he managed to keep his real loyalties a secret, he was caught just as he was trying to carry out his orders to kill Queen Meve.

During the sack of Cintra, Cahir Mawr Dyffryn aep Ceallach failed to bring Princess Cirilla to the imperial court, and Stefan Skellen was then tasked with finding, capturing, and bringing Ciri and Cahir to Emperor Emhyr var Emreis. To achieve this, he formed a band of various mercenaries and also hired Leo Bonhart, a famous bounty hunter. They organized the Scoia'tael attack on the mages' conference on Thanedd Island.

Spymaster Vattier de Rideaux and his network of agents were handed a crushing defeat which was orchestrated by Sigismund Dijkstra at the beginning of the Second Northern War with Nilfgaard.
